log.msg: Wave 8 cohered + COLD-VERIFIED. Fixed the boss-cam damage-number stacking with a vertical-lane system (root cause: ~85px horizontal slots vs ~250px 7-digit numbers) — verified 175,764 CRITICAL! now sits cleanly above 58,679 PHYSICAL. Dialled back arachnid core/eye glow so 5 spiders stop washing the crystal field. Handled a two-writer collision on combat.gd (the impact pass + the number fix) — confirmed the final file carries BOTH. Then wiped the whole .godot cache and reimported from source: renders clean, disproving a warm-cache-only warning, so a fresh clone works. Overall 9.5 -> 9.6. Named next gap: a shared text arbiter so loot labels + nameplates also lane against damage numbers.

Three parallel builders landed (env/enemies/combat), composite-verified clean. Floor rebuilt into cracked mineral-veined rock + grounded debris (ground depth ~5.5->8); arachnids now distinct menacing crystal spiders w/ telegraphs+flinch+dissolve (~7); the Juicer reads as a muscled hulk not a dark slab (~8). Caught a parallel-collision scare (a builder briefly wrote a wrong FastNoiseLite enum to the repo, since corrected) and a damage-number overlap — sent the overlap + frame-balance to a whole-game cohesion agent.

User: keep looping until very close to target. Fanned out 3 parallel builders on the highest-value IN-CONTAINER gaps — ground & environment depth (normal-mapped floor relief + grounded debris + fog recession), enemy/boss legibility (menacing arachnid silhouettes + telegraphs; Juicer fill so he reads as a hulk not a slab), and combat impact (dust, swing arcs, hit flash within the no-white-clip budget). Each in an isolated lab; composite + cohesion to follow. (The bigger leaps — bespoke characters, real-fps motion, audio — remain gated on a GPU/egress environment.)

Closed the named hero gap game-wide (player.gd). The heart-print boxers washing to white was the classic emission_operator=ADD trap flooding the whole short with base colour — set EMISSION_OP_MULTIPLY to confine emission to the heart mask, darkened the base albedo for contrast, saturated the heart red below the bloom threshold; hearts now read as bold red hearts close-up AND register in combat. The axe emission was raised above the glow threshold (blue peak 1.5, red pinned to 0 so it can only smear cyan, never white) so it genuinely blooms. Verified in BOTH the inventory close-up and a gameplay composite — no regression to the in-game Carl. Boxers 9/10, axe 8/10. Overall 9.4 -> 9.5.

Sent the one named gap back: the inventory pedestal Carl was a stiff grey mannequin. A builder replaced it with the ACTUAL rigged KarlPlayer rendered live in a SubViewport (own camera + warm key/cyan rim/cool fill, ACES+bloom, forced idle out of the T-pose, front-3/4 yaw sway) — unmistakably the muscled bearded in-game Carl with his cyan axe on the lit pedestal. Mannequin ~4 -> 8.5. Honest residual: the heart-print boxers wash to near-white and the axe glow is modest under lavapipe; both are player.gd material issues (they'd lift the in-game Carl too), which is the next piece. Verified a quick stage-lighting exposure tweak did NOT fix the boxers, confirming it's the material — reverted it rather than ship an unverified half-measure.

Screen bleed fixed. Root cause: a three-way alpha leak (scrim at 0.66 alpha, its opacity tied to the panel's eased reveal, but panel CONTENT drawn at full alpha the instant it appears) so mid-fade frames put crisp menu content over a see-through backdrop. Fix: fully-opaque scrim that ramps solid by the same threshold content starts drawing, plus a guarded occlude() that hides the HUD/loot/combat layers while a panel is up. Verified across the full composite: inventory + char sheet are now clean opaque menus, the floors intro still composes over the live HUD, and gameplay+loot+HUD all restore correctly on close. Overall 9.3 -> 9.4.

All three content builders landed (loot, floors, inventory/character). Ran the full composite — loot beams/box/gold and the System floor-intro compose cleanly, but the inventory + character-sheet backdrops are too translucent, so the live HUD, damage numbers and loot labels bleed through (exactly the composite-only regression that isolated labs can't catch). Dispatched a fresh whole-game cohesion agent to make the screens clean opaque menus and sweep for anything else.

Fresh session: rebuilt the cold toolchain (Godot import pass restored the class cache; warm capture verified rendering). Launched 3 parallel builders porting the last three.js-only systems into Godot — loot, floors, inventory/character screens — each in an isolated lab to avoid shader-cache races.
Godot port cohered and VERIFIED — beats the three.js build on world, HUD, boss and combat. Overall 9.0 -> 9.3.

Whole-game pass: ability arbiter stops VFX blowout (cadence 0.95s->3.1s, war-cry shaft cut, aura reduced to a hint), damage numbers 115px->72px, nameplates fixed_size+mipmapped. Fixed 2 of my camera bugs: unused CAM_OFFSET_BOSS (boss cropped to legs) and framerate-dependent follow (Carl outran the camera at 8fps).
All four Godot builders landed: world art direction (root cause: emission_operator defaults to ADD), characters (Carl muscle suit, Donut, arachnids, Juicer), HUD, combat VFX.
Proved Godot 4.3 Forward+ runs here on software Vulkan (lavapipe) under Xvfb and captures frames in ~13s — so the critic loop works in a real engine. Correcting my earlier claim.
Loot builder: rarity drop beams, ground labels, gold piles, DCC System loot boxes that pop open + auto-collect.
Launched 3 parallel builders on loot, screens, and the boss via a plug-in API — no game-loop collisions.
Whole-game smoothing pass #1: hero prominence fixed, scale/color cohered, world & combat wins preserved. 7.0 → 7.3.
